text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I took some painkillers, but
they're not
cuttin' it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, whining about it's not gonna make
it heal
faster. The rational thing to do is
get some
gaming in and try not to think
about it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...You really think you're safe right
there? I'll
teach you to underestimate
my aim...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Damn, this headache is killing me. I can't

concentrate at all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur's headache keeps bothering
her for
some time.
